verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents first-party REST APIs that let scripts drive core actions with no UI: the Marketing API can create contacts, send campaigns and generate account exports, and the Transactional API sends messages programmatically. Together these provide a headless control surface a CI job could call. However, there is no evidence of a CLI, CI integration, or automation-specific guidance such as non-interactive auth. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline integration, guidance on non-interactive credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Mailchimp’s Marketing API powers timely, relevant marketing campaigns with custom data pulled directly from your app.
Send a Mailchimp campaign. For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule. All other campaigns will send immediately.
Generate a new account export or download a finished account export.
Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) sends targeted and event-driven messages via the API or SMTP
